TITLE: Chronic fatigue syndrome and an illness-focused approach to care: controversy, morality and paradox. 
ABSTRACT: Contemporary medicine distinguishes between illness and disease. Illness refers to a person's subjective experience of symptoms; disease refers to objective bodily pathology.
